Name: Kana's Bathroom ( PIF)
Author: 7Kana
Description:
[size=5][color=#ffff00]My mods are only here on Nexus, please don't post my work elsewhere![/color]
[/size]
[size=3]Kana's Bathroom (PIF). Floors and Walls are replaceable and decoratable, bathtub functioning as a source of water and to recharge energy, animated bathtub and shower, and you can sit on the toilet.
If you want to change the name you see when you choose it, you have to edit the content file and under "DisplayName": "Bagno," replace "Bagno" with whatever you like in your language.
Version 1.0.2 With or without furniture configurable via GMCM

[size=3]Installation:
Unzip and paste into Stardew Valley Mods folder.

How do you go about getting it ingame?
You buy any door as long as it is PIF-enabled, hang it on the wall, choose the room, and go inside.
I created PIF glass doors that are purchased from Robin's store [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28160]here[/url]
Enjoy! [color=#ff0000]<3[/color]

Remember to install the dependencies or it will not work properly.

[/size][color=#00ffff][size=5]Thank you all for your support! It encourages me to create and share new mods. <3[/size][/color]
